content.text: Digital creators often face barriers when attempting to sell courses online, especially in countries where platforms like Stripe and Teachable are unavailable. For example, Stripe operates in only 46 countries out of 195 globally, leaving many creators without viable [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-12|payment]] processing options. This leaves creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Pakistan wondering how they can effectively monetize their content without relying on these restrictive platforms.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Courses teachable

Teachable and Stripe are among the most popular choices for course creation and payment processing, respectively. Teachable provides a user-friendly interface for course creation and management, while Stripe offers robust payment processing capabilities. However, their combined reliance requires users to be in countries supported by Stripe, effectively shutting out those in restricted regions. In contrast, sovereign commerce [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-selling-beats-online-crypto-payments-3|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]] like COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack provides a complete, integrated solution without such restrictions. It combines Cloudflare Pages, Workers, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/supabase-order-database-digital-stores-everything-you-need-12|Supabase as]], and NOWPayments, allowing creators to maintain full ownership and control over their digital products without dependency on international payment platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Both Teachable and Stripe have explicit limitations that exclude users from many nations. Stripe's operational footprint leaves out a vast majority of the world, effectively blocking creators in countries like Venezuela and Zimbabwe from using their services. Similarly, Teachable requires Stripe for payment processing, making it inaccessible to the same group. On the other hand, COREMERCH's architecture enables creators from any country to sell their courses seamlessly. By leveraging technologies like Cloudflare and decentralized payment options, users can bypass conventional obstacles, ensuring they can sell their products regardless of geographic restrictions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment processing, speed and fees are critical considerations. Stripe typically processes payments quickly but charges a fee per transaction, which may vary based on the currency and region. PayPal, while more widely available, can suspend accounts and withhold funds for up to 180 days, often without the possibility of appeal. In stark contrast, NOWPayments, integrated within COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack, has a remarkably low fee of just 0.5% and supports over 300 cryptocurrencies. This means creators can receive payments quickly and with minimal costs, enhancing profitability.
Take control of your digital sales with COREMERCH's infrastructure.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership of digital products and customer data is a significant concern for creators. With platforms like Teachable or Stripe, users often find themselves subjected to terms that allow these companies access to their information. This creates a dependency, where creators risk losing access to their data. COREMERCH's solution provides direct ownership to the creators. After deploying the Edge Commerce Stack, users retain complete control over their infrastructure, allowing for automated payment processing, instant delivery of products, and no reliance on external platforms.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Your choice of architecture should be dictated by your specific needs and the restrictions you face. If you are located in a country where Stripe and similar platforms are unavailable, opting for COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack is the clear winner. The stack offers a comprehensive solution that allows you to set up a fully operational online store in just 48 hours. Not only does it automate payment processing through decentralized networks, but it also guarantees your ownership of the entire operation, ensuring you are free from the limitations imposed by traditional payment processors.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Stop relying on platforms that lock you out.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
